svg.aria-label: The Periodic Table, arranged by increasing atomic number
svg.title: The Periodic Table, arranged by increasing atomic number
svg.desc: All 118 elements in their real groups and periods, coloured by the family each element belongs to, with the trends the lesson describes.
svg.text: Elements are arranged by increasing atomic number: 18 vertical groups, 7 horizontal periods.
atomic radius: falls across a period
electronegativity and ionisation energy: rise across a period
Tinted columns: Group 1 alkali metals, Group 17 halogens, Group 18 noble gases.
A dashed edge marks elements above Z 103, whose properties are largely predicted rather than measured.
